items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But he really didn’t like it, Paul de Barros.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s called . . . what is that called . . . “anti-social playing”. [Laughs] I think of it as anti-social playing. There’s a reviewer, someone reviewed . . . four guys reviewed a record I made a year or two ago and one of them, Paul de Barros, or something like that.
